Recipes.title: Mixed Greens with Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing
Recipes.author: Author name
Recipes.description: This recipe features a vibrant and refreshing salad made with a medley of mixed greens, accompanied by a flavorful sun-dried tomato dressing.
instructions: Soak the sun-dried tomatoes in the soy milk for an hour.
Chop the fresh herbs, tomato, and onions and toss them with the salad greens. Add additional veggies as desired
Juice the lemon and blend it with the soaked tomatoes, rosemary and thyme until smooth, then pour the dressing over the salad.
cardInstructions: Soak the sun-dried tomatoes in the soy milk for an hour.
Chop the fresh herbs, tomato, and onions and toss them with the salad greens. Add additional veggies as desired
Juice the lemon and combine in a high-powered blender with the sun dried tomato mixture and garlic until smooth. Pour over salad and toss together well. Top with brazil nuts and enjoy!
cookingNotes: Ensure the freshness of your mixed greens. Look for crisp, vibrant leaves with no signs of wilting or browning.
